builds.name: Nether Grasp ceiling
builds.summary: One Nether Grasp channel has 275+.8 AP plus 5-second target-max-HP zone. AP/penetration and burns serve both; raw zone expression has unusual .05 multiplier and requires tick validation.
builds.goal: One Nether Grasp channel has 275+.8 AP plus 5-second target-max-HP zone. AP/penetration and burns serve both; raw zone expression has unusual .05 multiplier and requires tick validation.
builds.hypothesis:
Malzahar Suppresses an enemy champion and deals [125 / 200 / 275 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage over [2.5] seconds. A zone of negative energy is created around his target dealing [(2 / 3 / 4 + (0.005) × AP) × (0.05)] max Health magic damage over [5] seconds.
Deathcap multiplies AP; Void Staff and Shadowflame reduce effective MR on magic packets, with Shadowflame low-health amplification tested. Zhonya/Banshee are high AP stat slots; Riftmaker is fully ramped before scoring. Mana variants use earned Seraph for mana-derived AP, read live; burn variants use Liandry ramp and Blackfire one-target AP buff, with proc damage separate. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.
